pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Proton Mail Bridge provides a local IMAP and SMTP server that relays mail to and from Proton Mail accounts for standard mail clients.
This package builds the GUI-less CLI binary from the upstream release tarball and links it against the system dev-libs/libfido2 (libcbor). A single local patch forces the keychain helper to use "pass" only and never probe the D-Bus secret-service helpers, which block forever on a host without a session bus.
